title: contacts=0 root cause

finding.summary: contacts=0 is empty Graph Outlook Contacts source, not a permissions failure or ClientCode filter bug.

graphProbe.interpretation: Authorized empty result — Graph returned success with zero Outlook Contacts cards.

rootCause.primary: Fabric only indexes Outlook Contacts cards (People/Contacts folder entities).
rootCause.consequence: When Outlook Contacts is empty, fabric contact index remains 0 even if mailbox traffic with client people exists.

accg01.note: ACCG01 contacts/next-action gap is honesty-correct: source is empty and bootstrap that invents history is disallowed.

safeLaterStep.description: Prepare-only contact candidates derived from entitled mail participants; no automatic writes without Owner gate.

doNot: Treat contacts=0 as a Graph auth outage
Claim ClientCode isolation caused empty contacts
Invent contact history to fill ACCG01 gaps
